title: Low-Level Design (LLD)
intro: Low-level design (LLD) interview questions test whether you can take an ambiguous prompt ("design a parking lot", "design a cab-booking system") and produce a clean class diagram in 30 minutes — using OOP correctly, identifying entities and relationships, applying the right design patterns, and writing code that compiles. This page covers the LLD prompts that recur most often, with the classes, the patterns used, and the Java code skeletons.
